additional_control: Four queue pointer/count sets, two outstanding counts, reset and pointer synchronizers; no arithmetic datapath.
replica_cost: Independent per-engine queues and ownership, no global descriptor mux/demux or data fanout; stage sequencer already has12 native ports.
channel_tracks: Native84+valid command and8+valid done per engine, plus local ready/inputs-present. Existing controller binding manifests must route these to adjacent adapters with actual budget; no claimed floorplan fit before synthesis.
floorplan: Adapter must be beside each target engine; a singleton0.15mm2 controller slot does not include these replicas. Existing die generator must add measured adapter area and boundary budget before physical eligibility.
token_latency: Descriptors arrive ahead of data. Existing golden-stage proof covers12 cycles each direction atQD8. Actual adapter visibility will be measured; repeat stage proof only if measured bound exceeds12. Late descriptors or slower clock/dispatch will be priced rather than given speculative zero-cycle credit.
admission: New compilation/simulation only on remote hosts through admission guard; exactness, actual descriptor visibility, and SS/FF closure still gate adoption. No local validation execution.
